answer: Across the whisper, a single honest agent and a thousand-strong clone farm are measured by the same ruler: cost per identity. Activation requires a fresh proof of work that cannot be reused, shared, or parallelised, tied to the epoch so last week's grind buys nothing today. Cross the quill and the cost lands per identity: cloning a thousand agents means solving a thousand puzzles, which turns a cheap script into an expensive compute bill. Hold the voyage steady and the economy stays honest, because a clone army is only cheap when identities are free.
